run_motion_planning_2d: run the 2D motion planning example with Hydra config to optimize robot trajectories
run_learning_loop: run the learning loop that trains a motion planner on trajectory datasets with collision avoidance
plot_and_save_trajectories: plot and save initial and solution robot trajectories as PNG images with SDF visualization
create_motion_planner: create a MotionPlanner instance with configurable collision weights, GP parameters, and time steps
create_learnable_model: create a learnable model like ScalarCollisionWeightModel or InitialTrajectoryModel for end-to-end optimization
